"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/capitalize-the-title/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

2129. Capitalize The Title

You are given a string title consisting of one or more words separated by a single space, where each word consists of English letters. Capitalize the string by changing the capitalization of each word such that:

- If the length of the word is 1 or 2 letters, change all letters to lowercase.
- Otherwise, change the first letter to uppercase and the remaining letters to lowercase.

Return the capitalized title.

Example 1:

Input: title = "capiTalIze tHe titLe"
Output: "Capitalize The Title"
Explanation:
Since all the words have a length of at least 3, the first letter of each word is uppercase, and the remaining letters are lowercase.

Example 2:

Input: title = "First leTTeR of EACH Word"
Output: "First Letter of Each Word"
Explanation:
The word "of" has length 2, so it is all lowercase.
The remaining words have a length of at least 3, so the first letter of each remaining word is uppercase, and the remaining letters are lowercase.

Example 3:

Input: title = "i lOve leetcode"
Output: "i Love Leetcode"
Explanation:
The word "i" has length 1, so it is lowercase.
The remaining words have a length of at least 3, so the first letter of each remaining word is uppercase, and the remaining letters are lowercase.

Constraints:

    1 <= title.length <= 100
    title consists of words separated by a single space without any leading or trailing spaces.
    Each word consists of uppercase and lowercase English letters and is non-empty.
"""


class Solution:
    def capitalizeTitle(self, title: str) -> str:
        words = title.split()
        result = []
        for word in words:
            if len(word) <= 2:
                result.append(word.lower())
            else:
                result.append(word[0].upper() + word[1:].lower())
        return " ".join(result)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.capitalizeTitle("capiTalIze tHe titLe"))  # "Capitalize The Title"

assert sol.capitalizeTitle("capiTalIze tHe titLe") == "Capitalize The Title"
assert sol.capitalizeTitle("First leTTeR of EACH Word") == "First Letter of Each Word"
assert sol.capitalizeTitle("i lOve leetcode") == "i Love Leetcode"

assert sol.capitalizeTitle("a") == "a"
assert sol.capitalizeTitle("to be or not to be") == "to be or Not to be"
assert sol.capitalizeTitle("HELLO world") == "Hello World"
assert sol.capitalizeTitle("a B c D e F g") == "a b c d e f g"
assert sol.capitalizeTitle("PYTHON is FUN") == "Python is Fun"
assert sol.capitalizeTitle("a aa aaa aaaa aaaaa") == "a aa Aaa Aaaa Aaaaa"
assert sol.capitalizeTitle("xXx XxX xxX") == "Xxx Xxx Xxx"
assert sol.capitalizeTitle("UPPER lower MIXED") == "Upper Lower Mixed"
assert (
    sol.capitalizeTitle("a" * 100)
    == "Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
)
assert sol.capitalizeTitle("ab AB abc ABC abcd ABCD") == "ab ab Abc Abc Abcd Abcd"
assert sol.capitalizeTitle("zZ zZz zZzZ zZzZz") == "zz Zzz Zzzz Zzzzz"
assert (
    sol.capitalizeTitle("a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z")
    == "a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z"
)
